name: Adventurer's Guild Receptionist
source:
"Welcome to the Adventurer's guild ♪!  What quests are you looking for?"

She is an NPC in XR working as the Adventurer's guild receptionist. If you think she has a common presence, you would be right and wrong. 
Because she...she exists in every guild in every city with the same appearance! There should be limits to how NPCs are handled. Of course, all the guild receptionists are identical sisters in the game. It'd be impossible otherwise. 
But there is no point in complaining about that. They are the ones who do the guild's work perfectly and always throw big smiles at the "players". How can one complain?
I can assure you that you will be enamored with the receptionist, whose name you don't even know.
Let's go see them today. Let's go see those smiling faces in the Adventurers' Guild!

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Human
Height: 159 cm
Occupation: Adventurer's Guild Receptionist
